scope: Existence of a collapse from its defining clause, abstractly: on a well-founded linear index order with a well-ordered value order, if for every index and every assignment of earlier values there is a critical value dominating the earlier values of small norm (Solvable), then a function satisfying the characterization (P) of #1463 exists, defined by well-founded recursion as the least such value. The dependent variant of the hypothesis is shown equivalent. With #1484 the collapse is then unique. Solvability for the paper's actual norm and criticality is not claimed.
verification: Exact original native Lean normal profile and named axiom output, with source-to-statement scope checked by the authoring lane and root; no separate artifact replay, no cross-model review.
later_finding: Same round, record #1486 (lane opusA): the hypothesis Solvable of this record quantifies over arbitrary earlier values, including uncountable ones, and is false for the paper's actual setting where critical values are countable; the actual collapse was therefore built with its own recursion carrying the invariant that earlier values are critical. This record remains a valid abstract statement but does not apply to the actual data.
